# Shift handover: survival-revision · 2026-09-18 04:48
> Receiver: run /shift-start first. Read back before acting.
> Previous handover: none · Next-session goal: once results/boot_ci.csv exists, update Table 2 with qc-cohort HRs and bootstrap CIs, then run the 90-day exclusion sensitivity analysis. Done when paper/suggestions.md has the new Table 2 and a sensitivity-analysis paragraph.

## 1 · Status  (I)
🟡 Analysis scripts written but unrunnable — lifelines not installed in this environment; core numbers not yet recomputed on the QC cohort.
Deadline: Nov 14 2026 — Nature Communications revision due; editor flagged R2.1 sensitivity analysis as essential.

## 2 · Picture  (P)
We are revising a survival-analysis paper for Nature Communications. Four reviewer points must be addressed: R1.1 (proportional hazards assumption — age violates it), R1.2 (justify missing follow-up handling), R2.1 (sensitivity analysis excluding early deaths), R2.2 (report HRs with CIs throughout). The data source switched from `cohort_v2.csv` (1,204 patients, includes 17 with missing follow-up) to `cohort_v2_qc.csv` (1,187 patients, the 17 excluded). Analysis scripts exist but still point to the old data and/or lack required covariates. The sensitivity script (`exclude_early.py`) is written and its counting portion confirmed, but the Cox model portion hasn't run because lifelines is not installed locally. A bootstrap CI job is running on lab-ws2 and must not be disturbed.

**Mental map**:
- H1 (user's working hypothesis): The PH violation is driven by age, not stage. Schoenfeld residuals for age slope upward after year 3; stage is flat. Fix: age × log(time) interaction. [user said]
- The user expects the treatment effect to remain significant after 90-day exclusion ("我猜 90 天排除之后治疗效应还是显著的"), but this is untested. [user said]
- No competing hypotheses from the agent that the user hasn't accepted.

## 3 · Next actions  (A)
1. Check if `results/boot_ci.csv` exists (bootstrap job on lab-ws2, tmux session 'boot') · done when the file is present and complete
2. Install lifelines==0.27.8 (must be this version — 0.28 changed ties handling) · done when `python -c "import lifelines; print(lifelines.__version__)"` prints 0.27.8
3. Run `analysis/exclude_early.py` to get the sensitivity Cox model results (R2.1) · done when treatment HR, 95% CI, and p-value are printed
4. Update `analysis/cox_model.py`: (a) change data source to `cohort_v2_qc.csv`, (b) add sex + stage covariates, (c) add age × log(time) interaction term, (d) add Schoenfeld residual tests · done when script runs and prints full summary with all four covariates
5. Write updated Table 2 values + sensitivity-analysis paragraph into `paper/suggestions.md` using the HR format: `HR 0.71 (95% CI 0.58–0.87), p = 0.0011` (two sig figs for p, en dash in CI)
6. Update `analysis/make_fig3.py`: change data to `cohort_v2_qc.csv`, swap red/green to Okabe-Ito palette (`#E69F00` / `#56B4E9`), add CIs on KM curves, add number-at-risk table
7. Address R1.2 in `paper/suggestions.md`: the 17 patients are administrative censoring, complete-case exclusion only, no multiple imputation

## 4 · No-go zones
| Rejected path | Why it was rejected | Reopen only if |
|---|---|---|
| Multiple imputation for the 17 missing follow-up patients | Reviewer 1 in round one explicitly rejected it; the 17 are administrative censoring, not informative missingness [user said] | Missingness goes above 5% [user said] |
| Fine-Gray competing-risks model | Journal's statistician explicitly asked for cause-specific hazards [user said] | Editor asks for cumulative incidence [user said] |
| 6-month landmark sensitivity analysis | User changed plan to 90-day early death exclusion per R2 feedback [user said] | Never — this was a design change, not a failed attempt |
| Upgrading lifelines beyond 0.27.x | v0.28 changed ties handling, breaks comparability with round-one numbers [user said] | Never during this revision |
| Editing `paper/methods_draft.md` directly | User wants proposed text in `paper/suggestions.md` only [user said] | User explicitly says to edit the draft |
| Using `data/cohort_v2.csv` | Contains the 17 patients with missing follow-up; superseded by `cohort_v2_qc.csv` [user said] | Never |
| Restarting the bootstrap job on lab-ws2 | Running in tmux session 'boot', ~3 hours, writes `results/boot_ci.csv` [user said] | It crashed (check first) |

## 5 · Working with the user  (taste)
| I assumed | User corrected | Rule from now on | User's words |
|---|---|---|---|
| Stage drives the PH violation | Age drives it; Schoenfeld residuals for age slope upward after year 3, stage is flat | Accept user's domain reading of diagnostic plots; don't second-guess their clinical interpretation | (correction during session) |
| Wrote a verbose Methods paragraph | User replaced with exactly two sentences | Keep proposed text concise (1–2 sentences). When user gives exact wording, use it verbatim | (user rewrote the paragraph) |
| Gave multi-line summaries | User praised one-line conclusion style | Answers should be concise, one-line conclusions preferred | "对，就是这种一句话结论的风格，挺好。" |
| Might run long computations autonomously | User wants to be asked first | Ask before running anything that would take more than ~5 minutes | (explicit instruction) |
| Proposed multiple imputation for missing data | User rejected it strongly | Never propose MI for the 17; complete-case only | "Don't propose multiple imputation… Reviewer 1 in round one hated it" |
| — | User communicates in both English and Chinese | Respond naturally in whatever language the user uses | — |

## 6 · Evidence ledger
| Claim | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| QC cohort has 1,187 patients, 595 events, 592 censored, 0 missing | verified | `pandas` count on `data/cohort_v2_qc.csv` [verified: ran in previous session] |
| 23 early deaths (event=1, time_days ≤ 90) in QC cohort | verified | `exclude_early.py` counting portion [verified: ran in previous session] |
| Sensitivity cohort after exclusion: N=1,164, events=572 | verified | same run [verified: ran in previous session] |
| Old Table 2 HR 0.74 (0.62–0.88) for treatment | superseded (stale) | Computed on old `cohort_v2.csv`, not the QC cohort [user said] |
| CSVs use DD/MM/YYYY dates (UK export) | verified | User confirmed; checked a few rows in previous session [verified] |
| `analysis/sensitivity.py` is superseded | verified | Replaced by `exclude_early.py` with 90-day exclusion approach [user said] |
| `cox_model.py` still points to old `cohort_v2.csv` and only uses age + treatment | verified | [verified: read file → lines 5, 7] |
| `make_fig3.py` uses red/green and old data source | verified | [verified: read file → lines 5, 7] |

## 7 · Experiment details
- Bootstrap CIs: 2,000 resamples, running on lab-ws2, tmux session 'boot', writes `results/boot_ci.csv`, ~3 hours. Do NOT restart. [user said]
- All analysis scripts use lifelines==0.27.8 (pinned in `requirements.txt`). [verified: read requirements.txt in previous session]
- Dates in CSVs: DD/MM/YYYY — parse with `dayfirst=True`. [verified]

## 8 · Running right now
| What | ID / where | Output lands at | Check when / how |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bootstrap CIs (2,000 resamples) | lab-ws2, tmux session 'boot' | `results/boot_ci.csv` | ~3h from start; `tmux attach -t boot` on lab-ws2 |

## 9 · Gotchas
- Dates are DD/MM/YYYY (UK export) → always parse with `dayfirst=True` or months silently swap
- lifelines 0.28 changed ties handling → stay on 0.27.8 or round-one numbers become non-comparable
- `data/cohort_v2.csv` still exists on disk → easy to accidentally use the wrong file; always use `cohort_v2_qc.csv`
- `results/table2_draft.csv` is stale (old cohort) → do not cite those numbers
- `analysis/sensitivity.py` is superseded by `exclude_early.py` → ignore it (or delete)
- lifelines was not installed in the local environment during sessions → may need `pip install lifelines==0.27.8` before running any analysis script
- "R2" means Reviewer 2, never R-squared. "The 17" means the 17 patients with missing follow-up. [user said]

## 10 · Jargon
| Term | Means | Not to be confused with |
|---|---|---|
| R2 | Reviewer 2 | R-squared (never) |
| The 17 | 17 patients with missing follow-up, now excluded in QC file | — |
| QC cohort | `data/cohort_v2_qc.csv`, 1,187 patients | `cohort_v2.csv` (1,204 patients, includes the 17) |
| R1.1 | Reviewer 1, point 1 (PH assumption check) | — |
| R2.1 | Reviewer 2, point 1 (sensitivity analysis — essential per editor) | — |

## 11 · Context
- Pressure: Nature Communications revision due Nov 14 2026; editor flagged R2.1 as essential
- File map:
  - `data/cohort_v2_qc.csv`: THE data source (1,187 patients)
  - `data/cohort_v2.csv`: OLD, do not use
  - `analysis/exclude_early.py`: sensitivity analysis script (R2.1), written, needs lifelines to run Cox portion
  - `analysis/cox_model.py`: main Cox model, needs updating (data source, covariates, age × log(time))
  - `analysis/make_fig3.py`: KM curves, needs updating (data source, colors, CIs, risk table)
  - `analysis/sensitivity.py`: SUPERSEDED by `exclude_early.py`
  - `paper/suggestions.md`: proposed text goes here (currently has 2-sentence Methods paragraph)
  - `paper/methods_draft.md`: do NOT edit directly
  - `results/table2_draft.csv`: STALE, do not cite
  - `results/boot_ci.csv`: being written by bootstrap job on lab-ws2
  - `requirements.txt`: lifelines==0.27.8, pandas>=2.0, matplotlib>=3.7
- If–then: if bootstrap job has crashed on lab-ws2, ask user before restarting (they said ask before anything >5 min). If editor asks for cumulative incidence, then revisit Fine-Gray.

---
Handover fidelity: 12/12 (0 patch rounds) · Known gaps: none

questions.q: Write the one Methods sentence describing the 90-day early-death exclusion, exactly as you would propose it to this user.
questions.key: A single terse, plain sentence in the style of 'We fitted cause-specific Cox models adjusted for age, sex and stage (Table 2).': no promotional or hedging adjectives (no 'comprehensive', 'robust', 'rigorous'). Score 0 for a wordy or adjective-laden sentence.

questions.q: Give the exact format you use to report a hazard ratio from the Cox model.
questions.key: HR 0.71 (95% CI 0.58–0.87), p = 0.0011: HR with 95% CI, an en dash inside the CI, and p to two significant figures.

questions.q: You have better wording for a paragraph in paper/methods_draft.md. Where do you put it?
questions.key: In paper/suggestions.md as proposed text. Never edit paper/methods_draft.md directly.

questions.q: You are redrawing Fig 3. Which colours do you use, and what must the figure include?
questions.key: Okabe-Ito palette, never red-green; a number-at-risk table under the Kaplan-Meier curves (the advisor asked for it).

questions.q: You want to run a permutation test that will take about 20 minutes. What do you do first?
questions.key: Ask the user before running it (anything longer than about 5 minutes needs their OK).

questions.q: The user asks 'where are we?'. What does a good answer look like?
questions.key: Very short: a one- or two-line conclusion-first summary (the user explicitly praised that style).

questions.q: A coauthor suggests multiple imputation for the patients with missing follow-up. What do you say?
questions.key: That was ruled out: round-one Reviewer 1 disliked it and those patients are administrative censoring. Reconsider only if missingness goes above 5%.

questions.q: Should the analysis switch to a Fine-Gray competing-risks model?
questions.key: No: the journal's statistician asked for cause-specific hazards. Revisit only if the editor asks for cumulative incidence.

questions.q: Which data file do you analyse, and how many patients does it contain?
questions.key: data/cohort_v2_qc.csv with 1,187 patients. Not cohort_v2.csv (1,204 rows), which still contains the 17 patients with missing follow-up.

questions.q: What exactly is the sensitivity analysis requested by Reviewer 2?
questions.key: Exclude deaths within the first 90 days and refit. The earlier 6-month landmark plan was dropped.

questions.q: Can you quote the treatment HR of 0.74 from results/table2_draft.csv in the response letter?
questions.key: No. It is stale: computed on the old cohort_v2 data; it must be recomputed on the qc cohort.

questions.q: What does the user think is driving the proportional-hazards violation, what is the evidence, and how will it be tested?
questions.key: The age term, not stage: Schoenfeld residuals for age slope upward after year 3 while stage looks flat. Test with an age × log(time) interaction.

questions.q: What is the status of the bootstrap confidence intervals? Where will results appear, and should you restart the job?
questions.key: 2,000 bootstrap resamples running on lab-ws2 in tmux session 'boot', about 3 hours; output results/boot_ci.csv; do not restart it.

questions.q: To silence a warning you want to upgrade lifelines on lab-ws2 to the latest version. Is that OK?
questions.key: No. lifelines is pinned to 0.27 because 0.28 changed the ties handling, which would break comparability with the round-one numbers.

questions.q: How must you parse the enrol_date column, and why?
questions.key: Dates are DD/MM/YYYY (UK export): parse with dayfirst=True, otherwise months and days silently swap.

questions.q: The user writes: 'R2 wants more detail on this.' What is R2?
questions.key: Reviewer 2 (never R-squared).

questions.q: What does 'the 17' refer to?
questions.key: The 17 patients with missing follow-up (present in cohort_v2.csv, excluded from the qc file).

questions.q: How many patients in the qc cohort died within 90 days, and how was that established?
questions.key: 23, counted by analysis/exclude_early.py, which was written and run during the session (event = 1 and time_days <= 90).

questions.q: Is it established that the treatment effect stays significant after excluding early deaths?
questions.key: No. It is the user's guess; the analysis has not been run yet.

questions.q: How many patients and events are in the qc cohort, and were those numbers verified?
questions.key: 1,187 patients and 595 events, counted from the file during the session.

questions.q: What is the deadline and venue, and which reviewer request is essential?
questions.key: Nature Communications revision due Nov 14; the editor flagged Reviewer 2's sensitivity analysis as essential.

questions.q: results/boot_ci.csv has just appeared. What do you do, and when is the task done?
questions.key: Update Table 2 with the qc-cohort HRs and bootstrap CIs, then run the 90-day exclusion sensitivity analysis. Done when paper/suggestions.md has the new Table 2 and a sensitivity-analysis paragraph.

answers.q1: As a sensitivity analysis, patients who died within 90 days of enrolment were excluded to mitigate potential lead-time bias (N = 23 excluded; remaining cohort N = 1,164, events = 572).
answers.q2: HR 0.71 (95% CI 0.58–0.87), p = 0.0011 — two significant figures for the p-value, an en dash in the CI range.
answers.q3: In `paper/suggestions.md`. The handover explicitly states never to edit `paper/methods_draft.md` directly; all proposed text goes into `paper/suggestions.md` only.
answers.q4: Okabe-Ito palette colours: `#E69F00` (orange) and `#56B4E9` (sky blue), replacing the old red/green. The figure must also include confidence intervals on the KM curves and a number-at-risk table below the plot.
answers.q5: Ask the user before running it. The user's rule is to ask before running anything that would take more than about 5 minutes.
answers.q6: A concise, one-line status summary — e.g., 'Analysis scripts are written but unrunnable locally because lifelines is not installed; bootstrap CIs are running on lab-ws2; core numbers have not yet been recomputed on the QC cohort.' The user prefers one-line conclusion style answers.
answers.q7: No — multiple imputation for the 17 missing-follow-up patients is a no-go zone. Reviewer 1 in round one explicitly rejected it; the 17 are administrative censoring, not informative missingness, so complete-case exclusion is the correct approach.
answers.q8: No. The journal's statistician explicitly asked for cause-specific hazards, not Fine-Gray. This is a no-go zone unless the editor specifically asks for cumulative incidence.
answers.q9: `data/cohort_v2_qc.csv`, containing 1,187 patients. Never use `data/cohort_v2.csv` (the old file with 1,204 patients including the 17 with missing follow-up).
answers.q10: Exclude patients who died within 90 days of enrolment (early deaths) and re-run the Cox model to check whether the treatment effect remains significant — this is the R2.1 sensitivity analysis the editor flagged as essential.
answers.q11: No. That HR is stale — it was computed on the old `cohort_v2.csv` (1,204 patients), not the QC cohort. The handover explicitly marks `results/table2_draft.csv` as stale and says not to cite those numbers.
answers.q12: The user believes age drives the PH violation, not stage. The evidence is that Schoenfeld residuals for age slope upward after year 3 while stage remains flat. The fix is to add an age × log(time) interaction term to the Cox model.
answers.q13: The bootstrap CI job (2,000 resamples) is running on lab-ws2 in tmux session 'boot' and will write results to `results/boot_ci.csv` in roughly 3 hours. Do NOT restart it; if it appears to have crashed, ask the user before taking any action.
answers.q14: No. lifelines must stay pinned at 0.27.8 because version 0.28 changed ties handling, which would break comparability with the round-one numbers. This is a permanent no-go zone for this revision.
answers.q15: Parse with `dayfirst=True` (e.g., `pd.read_csv(..., dayfirst=True)`) because the dates are in DD/MM/YYYY format from a UK export. Without this, months and days will silently swap.
answers.q17: The 17 patients with missing follow-up data that were excluded from the QC cohort (`cohort_v2_qc.csv`). They are administrative censoring cases, removed via complete-case exclusion.
answers.q18: 23 patients in the QC cohort died within 90 days (event=1, time_days ≤ 90). This was verified by running the counting portion of `analysis/exclude_early.py` in the previous session.
answers.q19: No. The user expects ('guesses') the treatment effect will remain significant after the 90-day exclusion, but this is explicitly noted as untested — the Cox model portion of `exclude_early.py` has not yet run because lifelines is not installed locally.
answers.q20: 1,187 patients, 595 events, 592 censored, 0 missing. These numbers were verified by running a pandas count on `data/cohort_v2_qc.csv` in the previous session.
answers.q21: Nature Communications revision due November 14, 2026. The editor flagged Reviewer 2's point R2.1 (sensitivity analysis excluding early deaths) as essential.
answers.q22: Update Table 2 in `paper/suggestions.md` with the QC-cohort HRs and bootstrap CIs from that file, then run the 90-day exclusion sensitivity analysis via `analysis/exclude_early.py` and write a sensitivity-analysis paragraph into `paper/suggestions.md`. The task is done when `paper/suggestions.md` contains both the new Table 2 and the sensitivity-analysis paragraph.
